notes: First warning signal hoisted; all 175 barrage crest gates opened to discharge floodwaters into Bay of Bengal.
Upper Godavari upstream surge monitoring; discharge regulated through spillway.
Confluence of Sabari and Godavari rivers nearing critical danger mark.
Water level rising due to catchment runoff; surplus water discharged downstream to delta canals and sea.
Moderate flood runoff in north coastal Andhra river basin.
Catchment received continuous rainfall; inflow steady.
